judgment.notes: M007 is instantiated over ℝ on Space×ℝ, first into Value and then into the recursively formed continuous-linear-map spaces. Each point of the open O has the required neighborhood equality, first by F001 and subsequently by the induction hypothesis on all of O. Constant derivatives are zero.
